canonical_name: Inchinnan grid connection (potential data centre site)
summary: A 180MW gate 2 grid connection reported by APRS (citing NESO's Existing Agreements Register) for 'Inchinan' — assumed to mean Inchinnan, the Renfrewshire village between Renfrew and Erskine with an established business park. No planning application, developer announcement or press coverage has been found; the site exists in the public record only as a grid connection agreement. No developer has been identified.
maturity_explanation: Only evidence is a reported 180MW gate 2 grid connection in NESO's Existing Agreements Register as relayed by APRS (page updated July 2026). PlanIt search of Renfrewshire 'data centre' records 2019-2026 found 6 records, none at Inchinnan (the two May 2025 data-centre-campus EIA screening requests were at Gleniffer Road, Paisley and Caplaw Road, Neilston, both withdrawn); no developer or press attribution found.

latest_development.headline: APRS data centre map (updated 29 July 2026) lists Inchinnan 180MW among five gate 2 connection sites 'not otherwise seen elsewhere'

unknowns: The NESO register row (connectee, connection site, dates) has not been independently extracted; the 180MW figure rests on APRS's reading.
APRS's spelling 'Inchinan' is assumed to mean Inchinnan, Renfrewshire; not independently confirmed.
Exact location within/around Inchinnan (e.g. India of Inchinnan / Inchinnan Business Park area vs greenfield) is unknown.
No developer or connectee identified by any source.
Whether the end use is a data centre rather than another demand user or storage.
Whether the two withdrawn May 2025 Renfrewshire EIA screening requests (Gleniffer Road, Paisley; Caplaw Road, Neilston) are connected to the same promoter as this grid connection is unknown.
